name: dsaireadable
description: The design system's tokens: three tiers merged into one document, then the theme. Light is the default theme; the others override the semantic tokens that change.

component.description: Tier 3 — shadcn/ui aliases of the semantic tier.

theme.description: A brand in a color scheme. Lyra is the default brand; nova applies under the .nova class on <html>, dark under the .dark class, and the nova-dark context under both.
